| Model / Tool | [Model or tool name, or Not applicable] |
| Prompt / Source Context | [Prompt or source reference, or Not applicable] |
| AI Suggestions Verified | [Yes / No / Not applicable] |

AI agents must mark `AI-Assisted Report` as `Yes`, name the model or tool, cite the
prompt or source context, and state whether every suggestion was verified. AI
output is evidence to check, never proof of root cause.

**Investigation Checklist**
- [ ] Inspect relevant application and service logs.
- [ ] Review request/response payloads.

## 12. Resolution & Verification Criteria

**Acceptance Criteria**
- [ ] Original reproduction steps no longer produce the defect.
- [ ] Expected behavior is verified against an authoritative reference.
- [ ] Relevant automated regression tests pass.
- [ ] Related workflows are tested for regressions.
- [ ] Fix is verified in the affected environment.
- [ ] Evidence of the successful verification is attached.

**Resolution Record**
- Fix PR / Commit: [Link]
- Fixed in version: [Version]
- Verified by: [Name]
- Verification date: [Date]
- Final status: [Open / In Progress / Ready for QA / Closed]
